🎮 GAN Generative Architecture Forensic Dossier

Project: Prompt-to-Game-Asset Generator • Dataset: 42,212 Audited Front-Facing Character Sprites (evilsocket/alucard-sprites)
Evaluation Goal: Independent AI Research Review on why adversarial training destabilizes beyond ~25 epochs and which architecture is genuinely production game-ready.

📋 Note for Claude

This dossier presents the visual outputs, quantitative metrics, and architectural evolutions across three distinct GAN runs on 64×64 discrete retro pixel art:
1. Attempt 4A: Discrete Palette DCGAN (Epochs 1–50)
2. Attempt 4B: Discrete DCGAN Continuation with Cosine Annealing (Epochs 51–100)
3. Attempt 5: Discrete SAGAN with 16×16 Self-Attention & Minibatch StdDev (Epochs 1–50)
4. Reference Benchmark: 280K Autoencoder (AE_280K_best.keras, 8×8×256 latent).

Please review the side-by-side contact sheets below and deliver an honest verdict on the failure modes, the sweet spot of training, and the viable path to game-ready asset generation.

3. Side-by-Side Visual Inspection

Discrete DCGAN: Epoch 10 (Peak Variety)

Best Diversity Distinct bipedal warriors, orcs, knights, purple mages on transparent alpha.

Discrete DCGAN: Epoch 50 (Mode Collapse)

Mode Collapse Over 40% of grid collapsed into pale-faced archer with detached floaters.

DCGAN Continuation: Peak Checkpoint (Epoch 52)

Grey Shrouds Grey rectangular boxes emerged as D forced boundary penalties.

DCGAN Continuation: Epoch 100 (Final)

Cocoons Complete anatomical collapse into green/brown twisted shapes without faces.

Discrete SAGAN: Epoch 34

Border Sync Self-attention synchronized corners, forming square tile frames.

Discrete SAGAN: Final Production Grid (LCC Cleaned)

Tile Framing Characters enclosed inside square portraits; rigid vertical totem poses.

5. Forensic Analysis & Questions for Claude

Specific Questions for Claude's Verdict:

  1. Why did continuing DCGAN from 50 to 100 epochs cause grey rectangular shrouds and cocoon degradation instead of improving details?
  2. Why did adding Self-Attention in SAGAN cause the generator to draw full square tile frames around sprites?
  3. Is it fundamentally possible for an unconditional 128-D GAN to achieve game-ready pixel-art anatomy without a spatial/autoencoder prior?
  4. Given that our 280K Autoencoder has an 8×8×256 latent space that reconstructs pixel art with zero artifacts, how should we position this in our final engineering defense?
